name: functions
description: Cloud Functions: public /v1 assistant API + production SSR wrapper.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=lib/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-functions --external:../build/*
scripts.build:watch: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=lib/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-functions --external:../build/* --watch
scripts.serve: pnpm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
